name: scamshield-mobile
description: ScamShield AI phone app (Capacitor). Talks to the ScamShield backend API.

scripts.serve: npm run copy-capacitor && python3 -m http.server 5173 --directory www
scripts.sync: npm run copy-capacitor && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
